# Search and sweeps

Single-axis and joint searches over one design space, and sweeps that resolve dynamic workload shapes. These are the pieces the loops above are built from.

## agentic_architecture_search

Search a compute array's spatial width, using a real local LLM (Ollama, no API credentials) to propose one width per round from a caller-supplied candidate set.

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `workload` | `dict[str, Any]` | Flux Workload IR document (inline dict), held fixed across the search. |
| `base_arch` | `dict[str, Any]` | Flux Architecture IR document the candidate widths are applied to. |
| `backend` | `str` | Evaluator backend name evaluating each proposed width |
| `valid_widths` | `list[int]` | Candidate widths to choose from |

??? note "6 optional parameters"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `metric` | `str` | `'latency_cycles'` | Metric name to minimize (or maximize, see `minimize`). |
    | `minimize` | `bool` | `True` | Whether a lower metric value is better. |
    | `max_iterations` | `int \| None` | `None` | Number of LLM-proposed candidates to try, or omit to use the full size of `valid_widths` (guarantees every candidate gets tried). |
    | `seed` | `int` | `0` | Random seed for the fallback-to-unvisited mechanism (deterministic). |
    | `llm_model` | `str` | `'qwen3.8:latest'` | Ollama model tag to use (must already be pulled on the local server). |
    | `wall_clock_budget_s` | `float \| None` | `None` | Real, enforced wall-clock budget (docs/decisions.md D73), checked before every real LLM-proposal-plus-evaluation round. |

## agentic_joint_search

Jointly search a compute array's width AND a memory-hierarchy level's capacity together, using a real local LLM (Ollama, no API credentials) to propose one (width, size_kb) pair per round from the caller-supplied candidate grid — the first agentic axis over a genuinely two-dimensional candidate space.

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `workload` | `dict[str, Any]` | Flux Workload IR document (inline dict), held fixed across the search. |
| `base_arch` | `dict[str, Any]` | Flux Architecture IR document with the named memory-class hierarchy level and compute-array dim the candidate pairs are applied to. |
| `backend` | `str` | Evaluator backend name evaluating each proposed pair |
| `level` | `str` | Name of the memory-class hierarchy level to vary |
| `valid_widths` | `list[int]` | Compute array widths to choose from |
| `valid_sizes_kb` | `list[float]` | Sizes (KiB) to choose from |

??? note "6 optional parameters"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `metric` | `str` | `'energy_pj'` | Metric name to minimize (or maximize, see `minimize`) — defaults to "energy_pj", same reasoning as `agentic_memory_search`. |
    | `minimize` | `bool` | `True` | Whether a lower metric value is better. |
    | `max_iterations` | `int \| None` | `None` | Number of LLM-proposed candidates to try, or omit to use the full `len(valid_widths) * len(valid_sizes_kb)` grid (guarantees every pair gets tried). |
    | `seed` | `int` | `0` | Random seed for the fallback-to-unvisited mechanism (deterministic). |
    | `llm_model` | `str` | `'qwen3.8:latest'` | Ollama model tag to use (must already be pulled on the local server). |
    | `wall_clock_budget_s` | `float \| None` | `None` | Real, enforced wall-clock budget (docs/decisions.md D73), checked before every real LLM-proposal-plus-evaluation round. |

## agentic_mapping_search

Search the flat-mapping space (spatial split × temporal loop order) for one op, using a real local LLM (Ollama, no API credentials) to propose one candidate per round instead of enumerating or randomly perturbing them.

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `workload` | `dict[str, Any]` | Flux Workload IR document (inline dict), held fixed across the search. |
| `arch` | `dict[str, Any]` | Flux Architecture IR document (single spatial dim, single compute node). |
| `backend` | `str` | Evaluator backend name evaluating each proposed mapping |
| `for_op` | `str` | The `id` of the single `einsum` op in `workload` to search a mapping for. |

??? note "6 optional parameters"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `metric` | `str` | `'latency_cycles'` | Metric name to minimize (or maximize, see `minimize`). |
    | `minimize` | `bool` | `True` | Whether a lower metric value is better. |
    | `max_iterations` | `int` | `12` | Number of LLM-proposed candidates to try. |
    | `seed` | `int` | `0` | Random seed for the fallback-to-unvisited mechanism (deterministic). |
    | `llm_model` | `str` | `'qwen3.8:latest'` | Ollama model tag to use |
    | `wall_clock_budget_s` | `float \| None` | `None` | Real, enforced wall-clock budget (docs/decisions.md D73), checked before every real LLM-proposal-plus-evaluation round. |

## agentic_memory_search

Search a memory-hierarchy level's capacity, using a real local LLM (Ollama, no API credentials) to propose one size per round from a caller-supplied candidate set.

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `workload` | `dict[str, Any]` | Flux Workload IR document (inline dict), held fixed across the search. |

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |

    | `max_iterations` | `int \| None` | `None` | Number of LLM-proposed candidates to try, or omit to use the full size of `valid_sizes_kb` (guarantees every candidate gets tried). |
    | `seed` | `int` | `0` | Random seed for the fallback-to-unvisited mechanism (deterministic). |
    | `llm_model` | `str` | `'qwen3.8:latest'` | Ollama model tag to use (must already be pulled on the local server). |
    | `wall_clock_budget_s` | `float \| None` | `None` | Real, enforced wall-clock budget (docs/decisions.md D73), checked before every real LLM-proposal-plus-evaluation round. |

The Verilog sibling of `systemc_generate_dse` (docs/decisions.md D45): generates and verifies multiple `DesignSpec` variants as real, independent, concurrent Ray tasks over real Verilator. Same arguments and contract as `systemc_generate_dse`.

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `variant_specs` | `list[dict[str, Any]]` |  |

??? note "3 optional parameters"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|

    | `max_repair_attempts` | `int` | `3` |  |
    | `cache_db_path` | `str \| None` | `None` | real, content-hash-keyed synthesis caching (docs/decisions.md D89) — pass the same path across calls and a variant whose exact final generated source was already synthesized skips a real Yosys re-run. |

## search

Run architecture design-space exploration: sweep a fixed workload across candidate architectures, rank by a fast screening evaluator, then confirm the winner through slower escalation rungs.

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `workload` | `dict[str, Any]` | Flux Workload IR document (inline dict), held fixed across the sweep. |
| `base_arch` | `dict[str, Any]` | Flux Architecture IR document the candidate generator varies. |
| `screening_backend` | `str` | Fast evaluator backend ranking every candidate |

??? note "13 optional parameters"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `search_kind` | `str` | `'architecture_width'` | "architecture_width" (sweep compute array width — requires `widths`), "noc_topology" (sweep NoC topology/dimensionality — requires `noc_topology_variants`), "memory_size" (sweep one named memory level's capacity — requires `memory_level` and `memory_sizes_kb`; docs/decisions.md D26), or "joint" (sweep compute width and memory size together, the full Cartesian product — requires `widths`, `memory_level`, and `memory_sizes_kb`), or "fusion_tile" (the one *mapping*-space axis: sweep a layer-fusion tile size over a multi-op chain through real Stream — optional `tile_sizes`, defaulting to the complete feasible space; docs/decisions.md D104). |
    | `tile_sizes` | `list[int] \| None` | `None` | Layer-fusion tile sizes to try for search_kind="fusion_tile" |
    | `escalate_contenders` | `bool` | `False` | escalate every candidate the screening data cannot rule out (its CI overlaps the leader's), not just the best point estimate, and re-pick the winner from those higher-fidelity results — the Pareto-front-relevance escalation trigger (docs/decisions.md D105). |
    | `widths` | `list[int] \| None` | `None` | Compute array widths to try |
    | `noc_topology_variants` | `list[tuple[str, list[int]]] \| None` | `None` | [topology, dimensions] pairs to try |
    | `memory_level` | `str \| None` | `None` | Name of the memory-class hierarchy level to vary |
    | `memory_sizes_kb` | `list[float] \| None` | `None` | Memory sizes (KiB) to try |
    | `metric` | `str` | `'latency_cycles'` | Metric name to rank candidates by. |
    | `minimize` | `bool` | `True` | Whether a lower metric value is better. |
    | `escalation_backends` | `list[str] \| None` | `None` | Backend names to confirm the winner against, in order |
    | `parallel_screening` | `bool` | `True` | Screen candidates as concurrent Ray tasks (default) instead of sequentially in-process. |
    | `result_db_path` | `str \| None` | `None` | SQLite file to warm-start against (docs/decisions.md D19), for both screening and escalation — pass the same path across calls and a repeated sweep (or repeated winner) skips candidates it's already scored. |
    | `wall_clock_budget_s` | `float \| None` | `None` | Real, enforced wall-clock budget (docs/decisions.md D71) for the *escalation* cascade only — checked before each rung's own evaluator call. |

## sweep_dynamic_shape

A real, honest cost estimate for a Workload IR op with a declared dynamic bound (e.g. KV-cache growth), by evaluating several concrete sample points through a named evaluator backend and aggregating the real per-sample results (docs/decisions.md D63) — not a new cost model, a real composition of the ones that already exist.

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `backend` | `str` | Evaluator backend name, same set `evaluate` accepts. |
| `workload` | `dict[str, Any]` | Flux Workload IR document containing a `{dyn: [lo, hi]}` bound on op `op_id`'s `dim`. |
| `op_id` | `str` | which op's bound to resolve at each sample point. |
| `dim` | `str` | which of that op's bounds is the dynamic one. |

??? note "9 optional parameters"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `sample_points` | `list[int] \| None` | `None` | concrete integer values to evaluate |
    | `arch` | `dict[str, Any] \| None` | `None` | Flux Architecture IR document, or omit to use the backend's own reference. |
    | `mapping` | `dict[str, Any] \| None` | `None` | Flux Mapping IR document, or omit to let the evaluator choose one. |
    | `metric` | `str` | `'latency_cycles'` | which metric decides the "representative" sample used for `bottleneck` — bottleneck isn't a quantity that meaningfully averages across samples. |
    | `wall_clock_s` | `float \| None` | `None` | Optional wall-clock budget in seconds, applied per sample point. |
    | `usd` | `float \| None` | `None` | Optional dollar-cost budget, applied per sample point. |
    | `result_db_path` | `str \| None` | `None` | SQLite file to warm-start against (docs/decisions.md D19/D86) — a repeated per-sample `(workload, arch, mapping)` triple, whether a duplicate `sample_points` entry or one recurring across calls, is served from the store instead of a real evaluator call. |
    | `n_samples` | `int \| None` | `None` | draw this many real, evenly-probability-spaced quantile sample points from `workload`'s own declared `dynamism.distributions[dim]` reference instead of a caller-hand-picked `sample_points` list (docs/decisions.md D87) — give exactly one of `sample_points`/`n_samples`. |
    | `corpus_root` | `str \| None` | `None` | directory holding the ingested distribution data `n_samples` resolves against; omit for this repo's own `knowledge/corpus/distributions/` (the same parameter the underlying CHIA node already accepted — previously not exposed over MCP, a review finding). |

## sweep_moe_routing

A real, honest cost estimate for a Workload IR op with `kind: data_dependent` MoE routing semantics, by resolving several concrete routing decisions (which `top_k` of the declared candidate experts actually ran) and evaluating each through a named evaluator backend, aggregating the real per-sample results (docs/decisions.md D68) — not a new cost model, a real composition of the ones that already exist, the MoE-routing sibling of `sweep_dynamic_shape`.

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `backend` | `str` | Evaluator backend name, same set `evaluate` accepts. |
| `workload` | `dict[str, Any]` | Flux Workload IR document containing a `data_dependent` op `op_id` with `semantics.candidate_ops` naming its real, sibling expert einsum ops. |
| `op_id` | `str` | which `data_dependent` op's routing decision to resolve at each sample. |
| `routing_samples` | `list[list[str]]` | a list of routing decisions, each a list of `top_k` selected expert op ids (real, distinct combinations of `op_id`'s own `semantics.candidate_ops`). |

??? note "6 optional parameters"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `arch` | `dict[str, Any] \| None` | `None` | Flux Architecture IR document, or omit to use the backend's own reference. |
    | `mapping` | `dict[str, Any] \| None` | `None` | Flux Mapping IR document, or omit to let the evaluator choose one. |
    | `metric` | `str` | `'latency_cycles'` | which metric decides the "representative" sample used for `bottleneck` — bottleneck isn't a quantity that meaningfully averages across samples. |
    | `wall_clock_s` | `float \| None` | `None` | Optional wall-clock budget in seconds, applied per sample. |
    | `usd` | `float \| None` | `None` | Optional dollar-cost budget, applied per sample. |
    | `result_db_path` | `str \| None` | `None` | SQLite file to warm-start against (docs/decisions.md D19/D86) — a repeated `(workload, arch, mapping)` triple, whether a duplicate `routing_samples` entry or one recurring across calls, is served from the store instead of a real evaluator call. |

## systemc_generate_dse

Generate and verify multiple `DesignSpec` variants as real, independent, concurrent Ray tasks (docs/decisions.md D41 — the same proven-concurrent `.chia_remote()` shape `agentic_multi_axis_dse` established in D34), reporting which variants came out genuinely valid — compiled and passed every one of their own test vectors.

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `variant_specs` | `list[dict[str, Any]]` | A list of `DesignSpec` dicts (see `generate_systemc_module`) — each variant's own `behavior`/`ports`/`test_vectors`, never an LLM-authored delta interpreted mid-loop, so the same design/its-own-checker independence `generate_systemc_module` gives one module holds across every variant here too. |

??? note "2 optional parameters"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `model` | `str` | `'qwen3.8:latest'` | Ollama model tag to use for every variant. |
    | `max_repair_attempts` | `int` | `3` | Bound on generate-verify-repair rounds, per variant. |
